status: Feasibility discussion only. User asked whether two ADC ports can be removed; temperature-interface choice is not frozen and active plan remains ten ports until a reduction is selected.

removed_ports: ADC10 / PB2, currently spare in all three single-power examples
nine_port_option.temperature: Keep the existing analog NTC role on ADC09 / PB1.
nine_port_option.advantage: Least change; no added temperature conversion hardware needed for the specified Vienna sensing set.

eight_port_option.Vienna_temperature_requirement: Retain temperature sensing through a separately designed power-board I2C temperature front end using the existing I2C port, e.g. external ADC reading NTC or a suitable digital sensor. This adds power-board hardware and firmware; do not silently remove temperature protection.
eight_port_option.limits: Eight analog ports cover the selected Vienna electrical feedback only, not an additional analog NTC. No unreviewed phase-current/voltage reconstruction is assumed. I2C temperature conversion is slow monitoring, not current-loop sampling.

recommendation: If the priority is fewer analog connectors, eight is feasible with an explicit Vienna digital-temperature path. If the priority is the simplest sensor electronics retaining analog NTC, nine is the simpler choice. The extra ten-port channel is not mandatory.
